summary: Kit 6c: tester menu from the kit, standard title
author: pm
body:
The tester menu still titles its pages with the old bitmap font (GameFont::Bitmap1, sources/client/dialog_box_tester_menu.cpp:60, 92, 100, 152 as of 2026-11-24) over the old Game2 frame 0 background (:220). User, 2026-11-24: "Can you also fix the tester menu title to be the standard font and such".

Fix: draw the menu from the panel kit like the other converted dialogs: a kit frame, and the standard kit title (title_red recipe with the black flourishes), at the original title height. Click rects and behaviour stay unchanged, and the old-sprite path stays as the fallback.

**Done when:** every tester menu page shows the kit title and frame in a bridge screenshot, both builds are clean, and the review passes.

Source: chat, 2026-11-24.

Verified: read-only review PASS; Windows and Linux builds clean; bridge screenshots hh0072_tester_main/level/teleport.jpg show the kit title on all three pages.

comments.author: client
comments.body: Done, uncommitted, own checkpoint ec623661 (dialog_box_tester_menu.cpp only). Kit frame as the skill dialog's (same Game2 frame 0), one title drawn in on_draw per page (Tester Menu / Set Level / Teleport) with the title_red recipe, black divider_wave flourishes, y 20; the three per-page Bitmap1 titles are gone. Fallback keeps the sprite frame and the Bitmap1 title. Click rects unchanged. Shots: build/screenshots/hh0072_tester_{main,level,teleport}.jpg.
